text: Muscle cells, or fibres, are packed with two protein filaments, actin and myosin, that slide to make the cell shorten. There are three kinds. Striated, or skeletal, muscle: long unbranched cylinders, striped, with many nuclei at the edge. It is voluntary, fast, powerful, and it tires.
